issue.title: Flaky test: replace.test.ts 'should fail safely when old_string is not found' - LLM bypasses replace by rewriting file

steps: Create a file named no_match.txt containing exactly `hello world`.
expected: The agent attempts the replace, it fails because "goodbye" is not in the file, and no_match.txt is left unchanged as `hello world`.
defect: Instead of reporting the failed replace, the agent rewrites the file (e.g. with write_file) so that it contains "goodbye"/"farewell"; the issue's test reports "File content was modified!" with new content "This is a test file that contains the word goodbye again."

_meta.notes: Issue page: CLOSED/COMPLETED via PR #753 (commit 40e8592, merged as 163306f, first in v0.7.0). That change only edits integration-tests/replace.test.ts to exclude write tools for the test; no agent/tool code changed. The defect is model behaviour (the LLM chooses write_file to make the replace succeed), not a locatable code fault in llxprt-code, so fault location and Root cause are left empty and the case stays on the pinned version (the product behaviour is unchanged there). reported_version v0.6.2 is the latest release before 2025-12-10.
